sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gyms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "equipment" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "gym_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gyms (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "gym_label" TEXT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "load_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "load_basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "increment_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2500, "base_load_milli" INTEGER NULL, "replaces_equipment_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "aliases" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "equipment_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "tracking" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weightReps', "primary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "secondary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "seed_version" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "gym_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gyms (id), "equipment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES equipment (id), "pinned_note" TEXT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "station_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "station_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_num" REAL NULL, "value_text" TEXT NULL, "step" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "gym_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES gyms (id), "trainer" TEXT NULL, "expires_on" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "gym_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gyms (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "rest_ends_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "station_setting_changes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "setting_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES station_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "old_value" TEXT NULL, "new_value" TEXT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "preferred_equipment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES equipment (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "rep_min" INTEGER NULL, "rep_max" INTEGER NULL, "target_rir" INTEGER NULL, "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL, "warmup_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tempo" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "superset_group" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "station_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stations (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "routine_exercise_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routine_exercises (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "load_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "load_basis" TEXT NOT NULL, "increment_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NULL, "rep_min" INTEGER NULL, "rep_max" INTEGER NULL, "rest_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL, "how_it_went" TEXT NULL, "effort_tag" TEXT NULL, "pain" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pain" IN (0, 1)), "superset_group" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "load_milli" INTEGER NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "distance_m" INTEGER NULL, "rir" REAL NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_checkins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_values" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "checkin_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES body_checkins (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "metric" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("checkin_id", "metric"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "checkin_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES body_checkins (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pose" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_prefs" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "password_salt" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_equipment_gym ON equipment (gym_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_exercises_search ON exercises (search_text)
CREATE INDEX idx_stations_lookup ON stations (exercise_id, gym_id, equipment_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_settings_station ON station_settings (station_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_setting_changes ON station_setting_changes (setting_id, changed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_routine_exercises ON routine_exercises (routine_id, position)
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_started ON workout_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercises_session ON session_exercises (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercises_station ON session_exercises (station_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_sets_session_exercise ON workout_sets (session_exercise_id, position)
CREATE INDEX idx_body_checkins_taken ON body_checkins (taken_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_body_values_metric ON body_values (metric)
